indicator: Cannabis seized by Douane (marijuana, hashish; kg and number)
bias_limitations: Enforcement-driven; mostly export and transit, not domestic harm. The steep rise since 2021 is not explained in the source.

indicator: Registered soft-drug offences and suspect registrations (Opiumwet list II)
bias_limitations: Pure enforcement measure. Possession of small amounts is tolerated, so offences mainly reflect cultivation and trade enforcement.

indicator: Soft-drug incidents registered by police
bias_limitations: Incidents, not offences: differs from the CBS series. Jump in 2023–24 not explained in the source.

indicator: OM investigations into large-scale cannabis cultivation
bias_limitations: Reflects OM priorities; capacity shifted to cocaine and synthetic drugs.

indicator: Cannabis farms dismantled (geruimde hennepkwekerijen)
bias_limitations: The 85% fall may reflect less police capacity and better-hidden farms rather than less cultivation (suggested in news reports; not verified).

indicator: Number of coffeeshops
source: WODC / Intraval, Coffeeshops in Nederland (via NDM)
bias_limitations: Regulation indicator, not harm. Supply to coffeeshops ('back door') remains illegal and unmeasured.

indicator: Coffeeshop prices per gram (nederwiet, imported weed, nederhasj, imported hash)
bias_limitations: Coffeeshop sample (about 70 shops); market indicator, not harm.

indicator: Perceived drug use / dealing nuisance in neighbourhood
bias_limitations: Not cannabis-specific; same series as for cocaine.

indicator: Electricity stolen by illegal cannabis farms
bias_limitations: Single estimate; only farms that were found.

indicator: Violence in the criminal milieu attributable to cannabis
example_values: Police split by drug is pooled; most liquidations are cocaine-related (78%)
bias_limitations: No yearly cannabis split; not usable as a cannabis indicator.

indicator: GI-TOC Organized Crime Index: cannabis trade score, Netherlands
bias_limitations: Only three points; expert judgement.

indicator: Experiment with a closed coffeeshop chain (Experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen)
bias_limitations: Future source for supply-side crime effects.

indicator: Cannabis use: lifetime, last year, last month, (almost) daily
source: CBS Leefstijlmonitor (CBS API, all ages) and NDM (18+)
bias_limitations: Self-report; daily use is the closest proxy for problematic use in the general population.
dataset_columns: h01_lastyear_use_pct; h01_lastmonth_use_pct; h01_lifetime_use_pct; h01_lifetime_use_18plus_pct; h01_lastyear_use_18plus_pct; h01_lastmonth_use_18plus_pct; h01_daily_use_18plus_pct

indicator: Elevated risk of cannabis use disorder (CAST screening)
bias_limitations: Screening, not diagnosis; few points.

indicator: Cannabis use disorder (DSM) in adults 18–75
bias_limitations: Single wave; earlier NEMESIS waves use other instruments.

indicator: Use among pupils 12–16 (Peilstation/HBSC) and 15–16 (ESPAD)
bias_limitations: School-based; misses dropouts.

indicator: Use among mbo students
bias_limitations: Few points; school sample.

indicator: Clients in addiction care with cannabis as primary / secondary problem
bias_limitations: As for cocaine: the 'all institutions' rise is partly new institutions joining; private clinics don't report.

indicator: Cannabis share of drug incidents per service
bias_limitations: Shares depend on what else is used; participating sites change.

indicator: Deaths with cannabis (F12) as underlying cause
bias_limitations: Too few deaths to be informative; possibly synthetic cannabinoids misregistered.

indicator: Hospital admissions with cannabis main / secondary diagnosis
bias_limitations: Coding of secondary diagnoses has increased; partly registration.

indicator: THC-COOH in wastewater (Amsterdam, Eindhoven, Utrecht, Rotterdam)
bias_limitations: Amsterdam heavily affected by tourism; THC-COOH measurement is less stable than for cocaine; gap 2013–2017.

indicator: THC content (nederwiet, imported weed, nederhasj, imported hash)
bias_limitations: Coffeeshop samples; potency is a risk factor, not harm itself.

indicator: Cannabis-related psychosis / mental-health care
bias_limitations: Candidate for data request.
